title: Software Engineer
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset - who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.

The Customer Experience Engineering Team builds the internal and external technologies that scale Snowflake’s global support and sales organizations. We empower our technical experts by providing the advanced tools they need to resolve complex issues and drive customer success.

Our team specializes in software engineering, data-driven decisions, ML, and LLM-based solutions. We build production-grade systems to automate manual processes and augment the capabilities of our technical staff. Our current focus includes:

- LLMs: Developing and deploying LLM and agent-based architectures for streamlining troubleshooting

- Scalable Evaluations: Implementing large-scale evaluations to ensure the quality and reliability of our internal and external tools

- Process Automation: Designing intelligent workflows that eliminate bottlenecks and allow our experts to focus on the most technical aspects of the Snowflake platform

- Incident discovery: using embeddings, LLMs, clustering, and agents to detect potential widespread issues more quickly

Now, the team is growing, and we are looking for a Software Engineer to join us. In this role, you will work closely with the state of the art LLM models, fine-tune them, develop agents, apply various clusterings, summarizations, embeddings, and so on. Even though we usually use high-level libraries (e.g., scikit or Snowflake’s Cortex) rather than perform matrix multiplications ourselves, some prior ML experience is definitely useful.

As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to the development of ML and LLM-based solutions, propose new ideas, and keep improving the existing models.

You will:

- Develop and refine ML models that are critical to Snowflake’s business

- Design metrics and experiments to validate your insights

- Help to implement projects that span our stack, including Java and Python services hosted in Snowflake and Kubernetes

- Collaborate with a cross-functional team, including product management and design

- Deliver features requiring close coordination with several partner teams

- Be a participant in defining the product vision and team planning

- Pinpoint problems, instrument relevant components as needed, and ultimately implement solutions

Our ideal Software Engineer will have:

- B.S. or M.S. degree in CS, or equivalent discipline

- 3+ years of hands-on software engineering experience

- 1+ years of working ML experience

- Interest in the State of the Art LLM-based solutions

- Great communication skills, both verbal and written and an interest in working with a diverse set of peers and external developers

- Genuine enjoyment of the art of building great software, and a love of learning new things

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

How do you want to make your impact?

For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com http://careers.snowflake.com

title: Product Sales, SME & Mid Market (Payments & Billing)
description:
ABOUT AIRWALLEX

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide - including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more - with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

ATTRIBUTES WE VALUE

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles https://www.airwallex.com/us/operating-principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

What you'll do

As a Product Sales, SME & Mid Market (Payments & Billing), you will drive net-new revenue across a defined territory of high-potential SME and mid-market customers in Australia. You will own the full sales cycle from prospecting through to close, with a focus on Airwallex’s Payments and Billing solutions and how they connect into our broader financial stack across our other products.

 

You will help drive adoption across key use cases including card acquiring, alternative payment methods, invoicing, subscription management and usage-based billing. You will also work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations and other cross-functional teams to solve customer challenges, provide market feedback and help shape how Airwallex scales its Payments and Billing solutions across ANZ.

 

This role can either be based in Sydney or Melbourne.

 

Responsibilities:

- Drive net-new adoption of Airwallex’s Payments and Billing solutions, including card acquiring, alternative payment methods, invoicing and subscription management, across SME and mid-market prospects in Australia.

- Own the full sales cycle across your territory, from prospecting and qualification through to solution design, negotiation, close and handover to post-sales teams, while consistently delivering against net-new customer acquisition and revenue targets.

- Lead structured discovery to understand customers’ billing, payments and revenue workflows, then collaborate with Product, Solutions Engineering and other internal experts to architect tailored solutions that combine Airwallex’s Payments, Billing and broader financial capabilities, including card acquiring, local payment methods, Global Accounts and FX.

- Lead high‑quality presentations and demos tailored to multiple stakeholders, including CXO‑level decision‑makers, clearly articulating the commercial value of Airwallex Billing.

- Leverage your industry network to open doors, secure new customers and create references, including case studies, early adopter testimonials and joint success stories.

- Partner closely with Strategy, Revenue Operations and Product Marketing to build targeted campaigns, segmentation and plays that accelerate payments and billing adoption.

title: Crisis Helpline Responder (New Zealand)
description:
We're looking for a part time Crisis Helpline Responder with proven experience as a helpline counsellor or responder, and completed training in Crisis intervention or Suicide prevention.
About Intellect
Intellect is a digital mental healthcare company providing an entirely new way for employers to effectively care for their employees' health & mental wellbeing. We're a team of psychologists, clinicians, and technologists providing an evidence-based approach to proactively help anyone, no matter where they are on their mental health journey. Our mission is to make mental health support radically more accessible, preventative & relatable, and stigma-free. Join us on our mission to reinvent how mental healthcare is being delivered
Role & Responsibilities

• Responding to telephone hotline for crisis support of those bereaved through suicide, engaging in self-harm, experiencing suicide ideation and concerned friends or family members.

Requirements

• 1-3 years of experience on helplines (paid or volunteer), preferably in mental health or crisis settings

• Fluent communication skills in your native language; proficiency in additional languages is a plus

• Experience managing high-risk situations, including those at risk of suicide or in acute crisis

• Resilience and emotional composure under pressure, with the ability to recover from challenging interactionsations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk case

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in mental health or emergency services

title: Medical Coding Team Lead
description:
The Medical Coding Team Lead supports the day-to-day operations of the Medical Coding Department by serving as a resource to coding staff and partnering closely with Coding Managers to ensure operational efficiency, coding quality, productivity, and compliance. This position provides technical guidance, assists with workflow coordination, monitors work queues and performance metrics, resolves routine operational issues, and supports training and quality initiatives. The Team Lead serves as a liaison between coding staff and management, helping to maintain consistent operations while promoting a collaborative and high-performing work environment.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Provide day-to-day operational support to Coding Managers without assuming direct supervisory responsibility; to include workflow coordination in alignment with operational priorities.

• Monitor coding work queues, assign or redistribute workloads as directed, and escalate issues that may impact productivity or turnaround times.

• Serve as resource for coders regarding routine coding questions, workflow concerns, and operational issues.

• Provide technical guidance and mentorship to coding staff while promoting coding accuracy and compliance.

• Reinforce departmental policies, procedures, and quality standards.

• Assist Coding Managers in monitoring coding productivity, quality, and turnaround time metrics.

• Support employee development through coaching, knowledge sharing, and education.

• Escalate employee performance concerns, workflow barriers, or compliance issues to Coding Managers as appropriate.

• Assist with providing ongoing education related to departmental procedures.

• Assist with ensuring compliance with ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, HCPCS Level II, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer, and organizational coding guidelines.

• Support departmental projects, workflow improvements, system implementations, and process optimization initiatives.

• Stay current with coding regulations, payer requirements, CMS guidance, and industry best practices.

• Maintain confidentiality of protected health information (PHI) in accordance with HIPAA regulations.

Required Qualifications:

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive medical coding experience.

• Previous experience serving as a senior coder, lead coder, trainer, mentor, or similar role preferred.

• Current coding certification such as:

• Certified Professional Coder (CPC)

• Certified Coding Specialist (CCS)

• Certified Inpatient Coder (CIC)

• Certified Outpatient Coder (COC)

• Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT)

• or Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA) preferred

• Advanced knowledge of ICD-10-CM, ICD-10-PCS, CPT, and HCPCS Level II coding systems.

• Thorough understanding of CMS regulations, National Correct Coding Initiative (NCCI), Official Coding Guidelines, and payer-specific requirements.

• Experience using electronic health records (EHR) and coding software.

This is a great opportunity for a DevOps/security professional to take real ownership of a live trading platform's infrastructure and security program, working closely with engineering and leadership to make both a competitive advantage rather than a bottleneck.

This role is fully remote (U.S.-based) and reports to the Head of Engineering / CTO.

- Manage and scale cloud infrastructure on AWS (EC2, S3, SES, ECR, Parameter Store, IAM).

- Own containerized deployments with Docker/Docker Compose, including reverse proxy and TLS termination (Caddy).

- Build and maintain infrastructure-as-code for repeatable, auditable environment provisioning.

- Improve observability across services - logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting for production systems.

- Support database operations (PostgreSQL, Redis) including backups, failover, and performance tuning.

- Own vulnerability management: scanning, triage, patching cadence, and remediation tracking across infrastructure and application layers.

- Support compliance and audit readiness relevant to a financial services/fintech environment.

- Perform security reviews of new infrastructure, integrations, and deployment changes before they ship.

- Champion secure-by-default practices across the engineering team (dependency hygiene, secrets scanning, hardened base images).

- Partner with engineering to reduce deployment friction and improve release reliability.

WHAT YOU BRING

- Experience owning both infrastructure/DevOps and security operations responsibilities, or a strong track record in one with real depth in the other.

- Production experience with AWS (EC2, S3, IAM, ECR, Parameter Store or equivalent secrets management).

- Strong Docker/containerization experience, including writing and hardening Dockerfiles and Compose configurations.

- CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance (GitHub Actions or equivalent), including OIDC-based cloud authentication.

- Experience with vulnerability scanning, patch management, and remediation workflows.

- Solid understanding of network and application security fundamentals (TLS, firewalls, IAM, least privilege).

- Experience with PostgreSQL and Redis in production, including operational concerns (backups, monitoring, scaling).

- Comfort with Linux systems administration and shell scripting for automation.

- Incident response experience - able to lead through an active issue, not just document it

title: GNC Engineer (Guidance, Navigation & Control)
description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Guidance, Navigation & Control Engineer at Applied, your role is pivotal. Your work will involve developing, integrating, and testing core flight autonomy capabilities that span all classes of aerial platforms (Group 1-5). You'll work closely with teams across the entire company to integrate core GNC algorithms into their software and product stacks, supporting applications in both commercial and defense spaces. The challenge is profound, and the rewards are immeasurable, as you build superior systems that empower our military with unrivaled capabilities.

AT APPLIED, YOU WILL:

- Write software that operates real autonomous aircraft systems including F16 fighter jets, group 1-5 unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), as well as simulated models to accomplish tactical military missions

- Build, leverage, and improve aerial autonomy software architectures that are ultimately tested and deployed on real systems to accomplish military missions

- Collaborate with DoD warfighter domain experts and 3rd party UAS vehicle vendors to develop and integrate aerial autonomy software onto OEM hardware

WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS:

- Master's degree in Aerospace, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Computer Science or similar field

- 6+ years of hands-on experience developing GNC software for autonomous systems

- Experience developing autonomy algorithms in either C++ or Python

- Experience developing or implementing outer-loop control systems or path planning algorithms

- Experience developing and simulating 3DoF or 6DoF models of air vehicles to support GNC algorithm development

- Experience with flight testing and performing data analysis

- Experience with UAS GNC/navigation systems such as PixHawk and Ardupilot

- Strong functional, procedural, data-oriented, and object-oriented programming experience

- Experience using git, Visual Studio Code, GitLab

Travel Requirements:

- Must be willing to travel as projects requires; estimated average travel is once every other month for between 2 days up to 1 week (~20%)

Security Requirements:

- Must be a U.S. Citizen

- Must hold or be eligible for a U.S. Secret security clearance

NICE TO HAVE:

- Ability to use data visualization and debugging tools to support autonomy control development

- Experience developing in Docker and containerized development environments, using Linux-based operating systems (e.g., RHEL, Ubuntu), source control systems, and artifact registries

- Understanding of key technologies: C++, Python, DevOps, Containers, Linux

- Familiarity with software-in-the-loop (SIL)

title: AI Service Analyst
description:
AI Service Analyst
ICS.AI · Remote (UK), occasional travel to Basingstoke and client sites
· Full-time, permanent · £26,500 - £30,000 · Entry level / graduate
Build the AI agents that run our service desk - not reset passwords.
ICS.AI is a UK AI consultancy delivering AI transformation to the public sector - local government, higher education and the wider public estate. Our clients commit to transformation on the strength of savings guarantees, and we are held to contractual service levels once our solutions are live. That makes our service data a commercial asset, not admin overhead.
We are hiring an AI Service Analyst to own the day-to-day operation of our service management function, and to build it properly from the ground up. You will be the single point of coordination between clients raising issues, the delivery and engineering teams who resolve them, and the Customer Success team who own the relationship.
This is a first or second role. You do not need to be able to fix the technology. You need to be able to work out what is actually happening, get it to the right person, and tell the client the truth about it clearly and on time.
What you’ll be doing

• Running our Zendesk platform end to end - reviewing every incoming ticket, categorising and prioritising it against a consistent ITIL-aligned model, assigning it to the right resolver and chasing it to closure.

• Early triage on live AI solutions: checking Azure service health, interrogating voice and language platforms, and reproducing what a client is reporting before it consumes a specialist’s time.

• Problem management and root cause analysis - spotting patterns across incidents, assigning causes, and authoring RCA documents that go to clients.

• Client communication and service reporting: proactive updates, SLA tracking, the weekly report pack, and service content for monthly and quarterly reviews.

• Monthly trend analysis across the client portfolio, and the structured feedback loop from live service into our product roadmap.

• Designing, building, shadow-running and tuning AI agents inside Zendesk for triage, classification and first response - including the guardrails that decide what an agent is never allowed to handle alone.

What makes this different from a service desk role
You will not be resetting passwords. Our tickets concern live AI solutions serving citizens and council staff - conversational assistants, voice services, agents and data platforms. And a genuine part of the job is building AI agents to handle the queue: that is what lets the function absorb a growing client base without growing headcount, and it is the difference between this post and a conventional service desk appointment. It is no-code work, but it needs someone who will iterate patiently rather than accept the first output.
What we’re looking for
We are not screening on a degree classification or a specific subject. What we care about is evidence of the following:

• Excellent written English - clear, accurate and appropriate for a professional client audience.

• Strong organisational discipline, and the ability to hold many open items without losing any of them.

• An analytical mindset; comfortable with numbers and spotting patterns.

• Confidence and composure in direct contact with clients by email, phone and video, including when they are unhappy.

• Competence with Microsoft 365, particularly Excel.

• A genuine interest in AI and in how technology is used in public services.

• Eligibility to work in the UK. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Nice to have

• ITIL 4 Foundation - not required at appointment; we will fund it within your first three months.

• Any exposure to a ticketing platform (Zendesk, ServiceNow, Freshdesk, Jira Service Management), including a placement year.

• Experience of local government, higher education or the wider public sector.

• Familiarity with generative AI tools, or any experience of configuring or prompting them

title: Security Engineer - Platform Security

We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. The Platform Security team (PlatSec) defends Plaid against attackers. We own laptop security, cloud security, AI security, detection and response, and red teaming. Right now we're in growth mode. AI has expanded Plaid's attack surface faster than most security teams can adapt, and we're building the guardrails, identity controls, and detection systems to keep pace without slowing the business down. You'll be Plaid's first line of defense on AI security. You'll review new AI technologies to find security risks before they ship, then design and implement the controls that close them. - deploying guardrails or sandboxes,

- managing AI identities,

- detecting or mitigating prompt injection,

- running AI security reviews, or

- implementing AI security tooling (built or bought).

- Experience at a frontier AI lab or on a security team defending production AI systems at scale.

- Experience on a Infrastructure Security, Cloud Security, Platform Security, Corporate Security, Security Operations (SecOps), and/or Detection & Response team

title: Chief Regulatory Affairs Officer (CRAO)
description:
Role Summary
The Chief Regulatory Affairs Officer (CRAO) is responsible for leading the organization's regulatory strategy, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and industry requirements while supporting business growth and market expansion. The CRAO serves as the primary liaison with regulators, government agencies, and industry bodies, proactively managing regulatory risks and influencing policy developments that impact the organization.
Key Responsibilities
1. Regulatory Strategy & Leadership

• Develop and execute the organization's regulatory affairs strategy aligned with business objectives.

• Advise the CEO, Board, and executive leadership on regulatory developments and emerging risks.

• Anticipate regulatory changes and assess their impact on business operations and strategy.

• Lead regulatory engagement initiatives to support corporate growth and innovation.

2. Regulatory Compliance Oversight

• Ensure enterprise-wide compliance with applicable regulations, laws, and industry standards.

• Establish regulatory compliance frameworks, policies, and controls.

• Monitor compliance performance and implement corrective actions where necessary.

• Oversee regulatory reporting and disclosure requirements.

3. Government & Regulatory Relations

• Serve as the primary point of contact with regulatory authorities and government agencies.

• Manage regulatory examinations, inspections, and audits.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with regulators, policymakers, and industry associations.

• Represent the organization in regulatory consultations and industry forums.

4. Policy Development & Regulatory Advocacy

• Monitor legislative and regulatory developments.

• Analyze proposed regulations and provide strategic recommendations.

• Influence policy discussions through engagement with industry stakeholders.

• Coordinate responses to consultations, policy papers, and regulatory inquiries.

5. Risk Management & Governance

• Identify, assess, and mitigate regulatory risks.

• Collaborate with Legal, Compliance, Risk, and Internal Audit functions.

• Ensure alignment between regulatory requirements and enterprise governance frameworks.

• Provide regular regulatory risk reporting to executive leadership and the Board.

6. Licensing & Regulatory Approvals

• Oversee licensing, registrations, certifications, and regulatory approvals.

• Support market entry initiatives and expansion into new jurisdictions.

• Ensure timely submission of regulatory applications and filings.

• Manage regulatory approval processes for new products and services.

7. Regulatory Change Management

• Lead implementation of new regulatory requirements across the organization.

• Coordinate cross-functional regulatory projects and remediation programs.

• Ensure business units understand and comply with regulatory obligations.

• Develop regulatory training and awareness programs.

8. Team Leadership & Capability Building

• Build and lead a high-performing regulatory affairs team.

• Develop regulatory expertise across the organization.

• Manage regulatory affairs budgets and external advisory relationships.

• Promote a culture of compliance and proactive regulatory engagement.

Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Law, Business, Finance, Public Policy, Economics, Healthcare, Science, or related field.

• Master's degree, MBA, JD, LLB, or relevant professional qualification preferred.

• 15+ years of experience in regulatory affairs, compliance, legal, risk, or government relations.

• Minimum 5+ years in a senior leadership role overseeing regulatory functions.

• Strong experience engaging with regulators and government authorities.

• Deep understanding of industry-specific regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.

Key Competencies

• Regulatory Strategy & Governance

• Regulatory Compliance Management

• Government & Regulatory Relations

• Policy Analysis & Advocacy

• Enterprise Risk Managemen

title: Post-doctorant·e en Théorie de l’information quantique des systèmes bosoniques - CDD 24 mois
description:
Présentation de Télécom SudParis :
Télécom SudParis est une grande école publique d'ingénieurs reconnue au meilleur niveau des sciences et technologies du numérique. La qualité de ses formations est basée sur l’excellence scientifique de son corps professoral et une pédagogie mettant l’accent sur les projets d’équipes, l’innovation de rupture et l’entreprenariat. Télécom SudParis compte 1 000 étudiantes et étudiants dont 700 élèves ingénieurs et environ de 150 doctorantes et doctorants. Télécom SudParis fait partie de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’école d’ingénieurs en France, et partage son campus avec Institut Mines-Télécom Business School. Télécom SudParis est co- fondatrice de l'Institut Polytechnique de Paris (IP Paris), Institut de Sciences et Technologies à vocation mondiale avec l’École polytechnique, l’ENSTA Paris, l’ENSAE Paris, l'ENPC et Télécom Paris. Vidéo présentation de Télécom SudParis
À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :
L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Missions

• Assurer des missions de recherche en théorie de l’information quantique, avec un accent particulier sur les systèmes quantiques bosoniques

• Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat des étudiants

• Contribuer à la notoriété de Télécom SudParis, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris

Activités

• Assurer des activités de recherche en théorie de l’information quantique

• Étudier les propriétés mathématiques et informationnelles des états et canaux quantiques bosoniques, en mettant particulièrement l’accent sur les systèmes non gaussiens.

• Étudier et chercher à démontrer des inégalités entropiques quantiques intervenant en théorie de l’information quantique bosonique, notamment des inégalités liées à l’action des diviseurs de faisceau et d’autres transformations bosoniques physiquement pertinentes.

• Développer de nouveaux outils mathématiques pour l’analyse des états et canaux bosoniques non gaussiens, en s’appuyant notamment sur des méthodes issues de la théorie de l’information quantique, de l’analyse matricielle et des opérateurs, de la théorie de la majorisation et de domaines connexes.

• Appliquer ces résultats à la caractérisation de la transmission de l’information à travers les canaux quantiques bosoniques, en particulier à l’établissement de formules de capacité ainsi que de bornes supérieures ou inférieures sur les capacités de communication.

• Explorer les liens entre les méthodes développées et d’autres problématiques de la théorie de l’information quantique et de la physique mathématique.

• Contribuer à la réalisation des objectifs scientifiques et des livrables du projet de recherche.

• Présenter et discuter les résultats de recherche au sein de l’équipe ainsi qu’avec des collaborateurs extérieurs.

About Paralucent
Paralucent brings clarity to complex work, helping organisations move beyond complexity towards clarity through practical, thoughtful technology solutions.

Paralucent Core Values
We’re Driven to deliver real outcomes, and we Take Ownership from first question to final result. We’re Creative Problem Solvers who cut through complexity to bring clarity, and we’re Humbly Confident, with high standards, low ego and a commitment to continuous learning. Why This Role Matters
You will enable Agile delivery teams to work predictably, collaboratively and with a clear focus on value. As an experienced Scrum Master, you will facilitate Scrum ceremonies, remove delivery impediments and support continuous improvement in a SAFe environment. You will partner closely with Product Owners, Release Train Engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen team maturity, align delivery to programme objectives and help teams deliver meaningful outcomes.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities:

• Facilitate Agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, sprint reviews and retrospectives.

• Coach delivery teams on Scrum, Agile principles and SAFe practices to improve delivery predictability and team maturity.

• Support Programme Increment planning, including dependency management, risk identification and alignment to programme objectives.

• Identify, track and remove impediments affecting team performance or delivery timelines.

• Strengthen collaboration across development, QA, product, architecture and business teams.

• Maintain Agile delivery artefacts in Azure DevOps, including boards, dashboards, reports and work item tracking.

Qualifications:

• Experience working in a SAFe environment, including Programme Increment planning and cross-team dependency management.

• Hands-on Azure DevOps experience, including backlog management, sprint boards, dashboards, queries, reporting and work item tracking.

• Demonstrated ability to facilitate meetings, resolve impediments and guide teams through change.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and conflict resolution skills.

• Experience partnering with Product Owners and technical teams to improve backlog readiness and sprint execution.

title: Content Specialist
description:
Mayflower is a technology company building large-scale entertainment products for a global audience. Our platforms serve millions of users worldwide and rank among the top-50 most visited websites globally. For more than 10 years, we've been creating reliable, high-performance solutions at the intersection of product, engineering, and entertainment.

We’re looking for a hands-on Content Specialist to help grow platforms’s audience by finding promising videos on our platform, editing them, and publishing them on third-party sites.
Your main focus will be turning existing platform content into videos that attract viewers and bring new users to the platform. You’ll also experiment with original content and paid promotion to expand successful approaches.

• Find and select videos: Explore platform content to identify videos with strong potential for external distribution. Refine selection criteria based on performance.

• Edit and adapt content: Cut footage, improve pacing, add branding and calls to action, and adapt videos to each platform’s formats and audience.

• Prepare publication materials: Create engaging titles, descriptions, thumbnails, and tracking links. Test different approaches to improve visibility and click-through rates.

• Ensure proper content rights: Verify and document creator consent and redistribution rights, and follow platform requirements in coordination with Legal.

• Upload and manage videos: Publish content on tube sites, and relevant third-party platforms. Maintain a consistent publishing schedule and keep accounts and content organized.

Requirements
You will thrive if you have…

• 2+ years of experience in content management, video production, or content distribution.

• Hands-on video editing skills: you can independently turn source footage into a publishable video.

• Good judgment in selecting engaging footage and creating effective titles and thumbnails.

• Understanding of how content can drive traffic and attract new users.

• Ability to use performance data to improve your work.

• Strong English communication skills, written and spoken.

• Ability to work independently, manage a regular publishing schedule, and meet deadlines.

• Access to reliable high-speed internet.

Qualifications that can be a plus

• Experience uploading and optimizing videos for tube platforms.

• Familiarity with video SEO, platform discovery, and audience behavior.

• Experience with paid promotion, advertising placements, or media buying.

• Experience developing original content and working with creators or models.

• Availability for collaboration during European working hours.

• Full remote work.

• An annual allowance that you can use for home office improvements, sports activities, equipment upgrades, and more-tailor it to what benefits you most.

• Investment in your development: paid language courses, access to various learning platforms, and a mindfulness benefit, including psychological support with 50% coverage.

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.
This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.
What this role actually is
You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:
• Whether the response makes sense

• Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

• Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

• Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.
What you'll be doing

• Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end

• Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think

• Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code

• Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)

• Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading

• Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"
We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

• Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

• Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

• Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

• Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.
Who you are

• Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

• Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python

• Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

• Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

• Strong written and spoken English (B2 or above). You'll be writing detailed feedback and recording short video explanations, so this is a hard requirement

• Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

• High bar for what good engineering looks like

Nice to have

• Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement details

• Rate: $100-$200/hour depending on experience and location

• Hours: 10-20 hours/week, flexible

title: Creative Strategist / Direct-Response Copywriter - Meta Ads (m/w/d)
description:
Rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat. Und du konzeptionierst die Videos, die den Account tragen.
Valkental entwickelt seit 2020 Outdoorprodukte für mehr Sicherheit und Komfort im Straßenverkehr. Über 400.000 Kunden vertrauen bereits auf uns. Unser Shop ist achtstellig. Deine Creatives sollen ihn auf dem Weg zu einem neunstelligen supporten.
Aktuell schreibt eine Creative Strategist unsere Ads. Du kommst als zweite Kraft dazu: mit eigener Pipeline, eigenen Ideen und eigenen Ergebnissen. Vollzeit, 100 % remote und mit direktem Draht zur Geschäftsführung.
Aufgaben
Kurzfassung: Du findest heraus, warum Menschen kaufen, und schreibst Videos, die genau das auslösen. Bis zum fertigen Creative im Account.

• Du sammelst Angles: aus Bewertungen, Kommentaren, Umfragen, unseren besten Ads und Swipes. KI hilft beim Research, den Gedanken dahinter hast du.

• Du schreibst komplette Skripte für Video-Ads: Hook, Body, CTA. Auf Deutsch (bald auch auf Englisch).

• Du organisierst den Content für dein Skript: UGC-Creator, Founder-Aufnahmen, B-Roll, Voiceover, Shotlisten.

• Du briefst den Cutter, gibst Feedback und nimmst ab.

• Du iterierst auf dem, was läuft: neue Hooks, neue Längen, neue Angles.

• Du führst deine eigene Pipeline vom Test bis zur Skalierung. Im Ads Manager siehst du, was sie bringt.

Qualifikation
Wir suchen jemanden, der Copy schreibt, die verkauft, und das belegen kann:

• Du hast Direct-Response-Copy geschrieben, die nachweislich Umsatz gebracht hat. Beispiele und Zahlen liegen bei dir bereit.

• Du kennst Meta-Ads im D2C- oder E-Commerce-Umfeld von innen und weißt, was ein Creative braucht, damit es verkauft.

• Idealerweise zwei Jahre Erfahrung in Creative Strategy oder Performance-Copywriting.

• Du denkst in Avataren, Awareness Stages und Mass Desires. Marketing-Psychologie ist für dich echtes Handwerk.

• KI gehört zu deinem Alltag: Research, Varianten, Struktur. Der Hook, der sitzt, kommt von dir.

• Du schreibst verkaufsstark auf Deutsch und verhandlungssicher auf Englisch.

• Du hast Bock auf Output. Viele Videos, viele Tests, viele Learnings. Und die Geduld, zu wiederholen, was funktioniert.

• Nice-to-have: Advertorials, Listicles oder eigene Media-Buying-Erfahrung.

Benefits

• Ein Account, an dem deine Arbeit sichtbar wird: rund 500.000 € Ad-Spend im Monat. Du siehst jeden Tag, was dein Skript bringt.

• Echte Verantwortung ab Tag eins: eigene Pipeline, eigene Entscheidungen.

• Klare Perspektive: Richtung Senior.

• Gehalt nach Erfahrung (nach oben offen).

• 100 % Remote innerhalb Europas.

• Flexible Arbeitszeit: Du teilst dir deinen Tag selbst ein. Was zählt, ist dein Output.

• Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung.

• Technik-Setup deiner Wahl.

• Zugang zu Corporate Benefits.

• Ehrliches Feedback, das dich schneller weiterbringt.

• Ein bis zwei Teamevents im Jahr.

Klingt das nach dir? Dann schick uns dein Portfolio.
Zeig uns Creatives und Skripte, die du geschrieben hast, gerne so viele wie möglich: für welche Marke, was dein Anteil war und was dabei rausgekommen ist (ROAS, Spend, Winrate). Geschwärzt ist völlig okay.
Praktisch: Deinen Lebenslauf lädst du unter „CV“ hoch. Alles andere (Portfolio, Zahlen, ein kurzes Wort zu dir) packst du ins Anschreiben-Feld (max. 10 MB).
Wichtig: Wir schauen zuerst auf deine Arbeitsproben. Gute Copywriter erkennt man an ihrer Copy.
Ein Bild von uns und dem Team bekommst du auf unserer Karriereseite.
Tabea und das Valkental -Team freuen sich auf dich!

• Technical & AI Literacy: High-level technical awareness of cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, or generative AI workflows-enough to evaluate dependency impacts and communicate effectively with engineering leads without directing technical execution.

• Objective Trade-off Surfacing: Exceptional ability to build transparent tracking systems that objectively surface capacity bottlenecks, resource conflicts, and cross-stream risks to VP and C-level executives without getting pulled into political arbitration.

• Dual-Delivery Balancing: Demonstrated experience balancing internal core platform development against custom enterprise client deliverables.

Nice to Have

title: Medical Science Liaison
description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Title: Medical Science Liaison (MSL) - GI Oncology
Natera is a clinical genetic testing company specializing in non-invasive, cell-free DNA (cfDNA) and liquid biopsy testing. We are seeking a Medical Science Liaison (MSL) for our Gastrointestinal (GI) Oncology portfolio to primarily support Signatera, our personalized, tumor-informed minimal residual disease (MRD) test. In this field-based role, you will serve as a scientific expert responsible for engaging GI oncology healthcare providers, sharing peer-reviewed clinical data, and delivering accurate information that proactively informs disease management.
At Natera , we remember there is a person behind every sample. The MSL operates with a high degree of ownership and urgency, delivering advanced genetic testing data that changes patient outcomes when timing and accuracy matter most. This role focuses on building strong scientific relationships, delivering clear and accurate clinical education, and bringing back actionable insights from the field to change the management of disease worldwide.
PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Establish and maintain scientific relationships with GI oncology healthcare providers and key opinion leaders (KOLs) within a defined territory.

• Deliver accurate, balanced, and clinically relevant education on Natera ’s GI oncology molecular diagnostics and clinical data.

• Drive territory strategy quickly and adapt as Medical Affairs priorities shift.

• Identify and communicate field insights, including GI oncology treatment trends, unmet clinical needs, and competitive dynamics.

• Respond to unsolicited medical inquiries in a timely, compliant, and scientifically rigorous manner.

• Support execution of Medical Affairs initiatives, including advisory boards and medical education programs.

• Act as a subject matter expert on gastrointestinal oncology disease states, clinical data, and the broader diagnostics market.

• Partner closely with commercial and clinical teams to support patient care without compromising scientific truth.

• Take personal accountability for doing things the right way, adhering strictly to healthcare regulations and internal standards.

• Support and coordinate clinical trial and research initiatives at academic institutions and regional study sites.

• Accurately track territory engagement and document actionable clinical insights.

• Travel 60-70% across the territory for clinical engagement and conferences.

• Adapt quickly to emerging scientific and clinical needs across the GI oncology portfolio.

QUALIFICATIONS

• Advanced healthcare or scientific degree preferred (Ph.D., Pharm.D., M.D., D.N.P.), with a minimum of a Master's degree required.

• Prior Medical Affairs or MSL experience in GI oncology or molecular diagnostics preferred.

• Must reside within the assigned territory.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

• Technical expertise and the research ability to clearly explain complex genetic testing data and clinical products to GI oncology specialists.

• Experience establishing strong, collaborative working relationships with internal teams and external customers.

• Ability to work independently and remotely while maintaining a strong team-oriented work ethic.

• Navigate ambiguity effectively and take the initiative to build structure and processes where none currently exist.

• Use clear, straightforward language to communicate clinical evidence effectively without heavy jargon.

• Demonstrate flexibility and the capacity to adjust quickly to unexpected clinical tasks or strategy shifts.

• High level of personal accountability, ownership, and sound scientific judgment.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS & WORK ENVIRONMENT

title: Addetto/a Vendite e Formazione sul Campo — Sephora Roma (m/f/x)
description:
Chi è Yepoda

Innovazione K-Beauty pulita. Senza compromessi.

Yepoda è un marchio di clean K-Beauty che dimostra davvero la sua efficacia. Realizziamo skincare coreana senza alcun compromesso: testata clinicamente, 100% vegana e formulata al di sopra degli standard UE. Otterrai quindi l'innovazione e i risultati per cui la K-Beauty è conosciuta, insieme a un impegno reale verso la sostenibilità. E rendiamo tutto questo semplice e piacevole da usare, skincare che si ha davvero voglia di utilizzare.

Fondata nel 2020 da Sander Joonyoung van Bladel e Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda è certificata B Corp™ e membro di 1% for the Planet, con sede nel cuore di Berlino. I nostri prodotti sono disponibili tramite il nostro shop online e, da marzo 2025, presso Sephora Europa, online e in oltre 650 negozi. Con un team di oltre 140 persone straordinarie provenienti da tutto il mondo, plasmiamo ogni giorno la storia di Yepoda.

L'opportunità

Yepoda sta crescendo rapidamente in tutta Europa e si sta espandendo a livello internazionale, stiamo costruendo il nostro primo team sul campo. Questa è la tua occasione per farne parte fin dal primo giorno.

Sarai il/la rappresentante di Yepoda all'interno di Sephora Italia, non un/una Beauty Advisor, ma un ruolo commerciale sul campo. Guiderai le vendite nei tuoi punti vendita, formerai e affiancherai i team di Beauty Advisor di Sephora, gestirai la relazione con i negozi e assicurerai che la presentazione del nostro marchio sia impeccabile in negozio. In parte account executive, in parte formatore/formatrice sul campo, in parte responsabile vendite retail. Sarai responsabile della relazione, della formazione e delle vendite in quattro punti vendita Sephora a Roma.

I Dettagli

- Contratto: Contratto a Tempo Determinato (CTD) di 6 mesi, con inizio a ottobre. Rinnovabile di comune accordo, con possibilità di diventare un ruolo permanente in base alle performance.

- Orario: Tempo pieno, 5 giorni a settimana inclusa copertura nei fine settimana, i weekend sono i giorni di maggiore affluenza per vendite e formazione. Il pattern esatto (martedì-sabato o mercoledì-domenica) sarà confermato all'assunzione e potrà variare stagionalmente.

- Trasferte: Fino al 20% del tuo tempo, soggetto a variazioni stagionali e alle esigenze del business. Copre i tuoi punti vendita oltre a supporto occasionale in occasione di eventi Yepoda. Yepoda coprirà le spese di trasferta (alloggio, trasporto e indennità pasti).

- Riporta a: Sales & Education Manager, EU

- Sede: Roma, Italia, ruolo sul campo, in negozio

Le Tue Attività

- Guidare le vendite nei tuoi punti vendita e raggiungere gli obiettivi mensili e trimestrali

- Vendere fianco a fianco con i Beauty Advisor Sephora per aumentare il tasso di conversione e lo scontrino medio

- Negoziare e organizzare momenti di marca dedicati, tra cui sales challenge, iniziative Beauty Hub e giornate a tema

- Formare i team di Beauty Advisor Sephora sui nostri prodotti, le routine e la storia del brand, dai brevi briefing in negozio alle sessioni complete tipo colazione

- Affiancare lo staff Sephora su tecniche di vendita, costruzione di routine e cross-selling

- Curare la formazione in occasione dei lanci prodotto, affinché ogni novità sia supportata da un team in negozio sicuro e preparato

- Assistere l'EU Retail & Education Manager in eventi formativi su larga scala e giornate stampa

- Essere il volto di Yepoda in negozio e gestire la relazione con gli Store Manager e i team BA

- Mantenere gondole ed espositori impeccabili, tester riforniti e livelli di stock adeguati a ogni visita

- Inviare report settimanali sul campo relativi a sell-out per punto vendita, merchandising e foto dei tester

- Segnalare le attività della concorrenza e gli insight dei clienti utili a definire le nostre strategie commerciali

Il Tuo Profilo

- 2-5 anni di esperienza nella vendita e formazione in cosmetica di prestigio, oppure Beauty Advisor senior pronto/a a fare il passo successivo nella prop

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that AGI benefits all of humanity.

Our Communications team supports OpenAI’s mission and goals by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, values, and approach to safely building powerful AI. The Internal Communications team aims to create clarity, trust, and shared understanding that inspires our employees to do their best work. We partner across the company to craft clear, compelling narratives about what’s being built, why it matters, how it aligns to our strategy, and most importantly, how it advances our mission.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for an experienced internal communications leader to own the strategy for our Enterprise & Growth portfolio, spanning B2B, Revenue, Partnerships, Marketing, Enterprise Engineering, Ads, Commerce, and Consumer Verticals. These teams are changing how businesses operate, bringing AI into working life, and expanding access to its benefits. This work is central to our mission of ensuring AGI benefits all of humanity: helping people and businesses everywhere put AI to use in ways that improve their lives and livelihoods.

You will have the opportunity to work closely with executives to help employees understand where the business is going, why decisions are being made, and how their work ladders up. You will often need to get up to speed on unfamiliar topics, recommend a path with incomplete information, and adjust as decisions evolve. We’re looking for a pro who takes initiative, understands what matters to employees, and anticipates tough questions and pain points early enough to help leaders address them.

This role can be based in San Francisco or New York City. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

title: IT Engineer
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a hands-on technical role. You will join during a period of high growth for the IT team as the company expands its headcount, global footprint and opens new offices.

You will work closely with the Security and Operations teams to keep our endpoints, offices, networks, and SaaS tools secure, while making sure people stay as productive as possible with the tools we have.

You'll own and deliver technical projects across identity, endpoint management, office infrastructure, automation, and compliance, helping us build scalable IT systems that support the company as it grows.

REQUIREMENTS

- Strong hands-on background in IT Engineering, Technical Operations, or a DevOps-adjacent role, with an automation-first mindset and experience managing enterprise scale IT systems

- Strong knowledge of identity and access management technologies (SAML, SCIM, OIDC) with tools such as Okta and Google Workspace

- Expertise with Mobile Device Management tooling (e.g. Jamf, Kandji, Fleet) across a device fleet.

- Scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) with a proven track record of automating compliance checks, device configuration, and other IT security tasks.

- Experience managing office network equipment (e.g. Cisco Meraki, Ubiquiti), including office buildouts.

- Proven ability to maintain compliance with SOC 2 / ISO 27001

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
As an expert, you will create Reinforcement Learning Environments that test an AI model’s ability to design, deploy, troubleshoot, secure, scale, and recover production-grade cloud infrastructure. • Design, develop, and implement realistic cloud infrastructure environments to evaluate AI model proficiency in systems design, deployment, and troubleshooting.

• Create detailed and reproducible scenarios involving distributed systems, networking, Identity and Access Management (IAM), message queues, persistent storage, observability, rolling deployments, and disaster recovery.

• Develop deterministic validation tests and golden reference solutions to ensure the reliability and accuracy of reinforcement learning environments.

• Produce intentionally defective variants and failure scenarios to rigorously test AI model responses and recovery strategies.

• Document the architecture, edge cases, and operational flows for all developed environments, ensuring clarity and reproducibility for future use.

• Collaborate with technical leads and project participants to iteratively refine environment specifications and acceptance criteria.

• Apply DevOps and infrastructure automation practices to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions for cloud-based systems evaluation.

Preferred Qualifications

• Proven expertise with backend programming languages, such as C++, Python, Rust, GoLang, JAVA, or JavaScript.

• Strong practical experience with DevOps, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and automation tools.

• Demonstrated ability to architect, scale, and secure distributed systems in production-grade environments.

• Deep understanding of networking, IAM, queues, durable storage, and disaster recovery concepts.

Process:

In this role you will leverage BTP services across application development, integration, data and analytics, and AI to deliver clean-core extensions of SAP S/4HANA and other SAP applications. description:

title: Web Operations Manager
description:
About Vasion

For more than a decade, Vasion has been helping companies simplify their print infrastructure, automate business processes, and integrate their technology in a more secure environment. Our mission, to make digital transformation attainable for everyone, drives a culture of innovation and exploration. We have one simple goal: help organizations simplify processes through automation and integration.

So we created simple, cost-effective, and easy-to-implement digital tools that work together, removing bottlenecks and improving efficiency. And we’re always on the lookout for new people who can help us innovate, grow, and reach our goal.

About the role

This role is remote, or hybrid for candidates within commuting distance of one of our offices in St. George or Lehi, UT.

Reporting to the Director, Digital Marketing, the Web Operations Manager is the operational engine of Vasion 's web team - the person who turns business requests into shipped pages and the person who keeps the team's delivery rhythm on track.

This role owns Vasion 's CMS day to day: building and editing pages and landing pages using existing components and templates, and knowing when a request can be handled directly versus when it needs to be scoped and handed to a developer or designer. This role also runs the team's operating cadence - standups, sprint planning, prioritization, and retros - and is the first stop for any stakeholder across Marketing who needs something from the web team. A big part of the job is translating a business ask ("we need a new campaign page," "this section needs to change") into a clear, actionable requirement someone can actually execute against, then following it through to done. Daily partners include web developers, UX/UI designers, the Head of Search & AI Visibility, content, customer marketing, growth marketing, and regional marketing managers.

What you'll do

CMS Management & Page Execution

• Build, edit, and publish webpages and landing pages directly in the CMS, using existing components and templates, based on business requests from across Marketing and the broader business

• Own the intake process for web requests: gather requirements, ask clarifying questions, and turn an ambiguous business ask into a clear, actionable spec

• Determine the right path for each request - execute it directly when it's within scope, or scope it and hand it to the right teammate (developer, UX/UI designer, etc.) when it requires new components or dev work

• Maintain governance over templates, components, and design-system usage across the site so pages stay consistent as more people request changes

• Handle redirect management, URL governance, and the ongoing consolidation of Vasion 's multi-brand web footprint

• Monitor Core Web Vitals, site speed, uptime, and overall page performance, and flag/triage issues as they come up

• Ensure pages meet accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2 Level AA, WCAG 2.1 AA minimum), conducting basic accessibility checks and coordinating remediation with developers when issues are found

Team Operations & Delivery

• Run web team standups, sprint planning, prioritization meetings, and retros

• Build and maintain the roadmap for Vasion 's web and digital properties, and own sprint health (committed-work completion, blocker resolution, cycle time)

• Serve as the first point of contact for any stakeholder engaging the web team - triage inbound requests and turn them into scoped roadmap items

• Coordinate QA, cross-browser testing, regression testing, and releases with the development team

• Support localization and multi-region site execution in partnership with content and regional marketing teams

Search & Conversion Execution

• Implement technical SEO and AEO/GEO content structuring on pages, based on strategy and priorities set by leadership

• Build, QA, and ship CRO tests defined in partnership with leadership

• Surface technical feasibility and constraints back to leadership to help

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.

We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Development Representative (SDR), you will drive business growth by identifying opportunities with target clients. You’ll play a pivotal role in identifying potential customers, generating new business opportunities, and providing support to both customers and our team. You will set the stage for successful sales interactions through cold outreach efforts and nurturing relationships to secure qualified meetings for our sales team. If you’re a self-motivated individual with a passion for sales, we encourage you to join our team!

This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Responsibilities:

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.

•
Sales: Understand current and future demand. Enable, educate, and directly support the sales force to best position this practice with Toptal clients and win new business. Lead client conversations, presenting Toptal ’s perspective on innovation and experience topics, and ask exploratory questions to better understand client needs.

•

Communicating via Zoom and Slack is critical to maintaining a high level of collaboration and clear communication within the team.

•
Growth and Development: Our team has an aversion to complacency. We are always looking to improve both individually and as a team. Being open to and implementing feedback will be critical success factors in this role and at Toptal . As you become more comfortable in the role, you will help evolve our demand generation strategy and tactics.

• Understand our sales method and our selling process to set you up for success.
